title: 第25章 启阵遁走，远赴雪原
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
天亮时分，两人离开了枯柳坡。

    没有回黑石镇，而是沿黑风岭西麓的古河道一路向西北方向疾行。

    苏余在途中将计划说了一遍——天机阁的消息风波在三日后溶洞开放时会达到顶峰。

    等各方势力在溶洞中扑空、发现宝物是假的之后，所有追查的矛头都会指向最后一个从秘境方向出来的人——也就是他。

    三天之内，必须将废矿中的七颗灵种和守种兽全部转移到更安全的地方。

    苏白石玉简中提到过，黑风岭深处有一座废弃的传送阵，是时族鼎盛时期修建的应急通道，通往北域雪原。

    如果那座传送阵还能用，就可以在三天内完成转移。

    林霜听完之后只说了一句话：“走。”

    两人沿着古河道疾行一整天，在第二天凌晨回到了废弃灵矿。

    灵矿入口的嗜血藤又长出了新的暗红色嫩芽，矿洞深处那七颗种在岩壁上的种子已经全部发芽了。

    赤阳果的嫩芽是火红色的，两片子叶刚破土而出。

    碧心兰的嫩芽是翠绿色的，细如发丝，空气中弥漫着极淡的兰花香。

    雪玉参的嫩芽纯白如雪，芽尖上凝结着一滴晶莹的灵露。

    墨髓花的嫩芽漆黑如墨，子叶上覆盖着一层极细的银色绒毛。

    另外三颗无名种子中，有一颗的嫩芽是淡金色的，与苏余掌心的星云印记一模一样。

    另外两颗仍没有动静——它们在等待更浓郁的时痕灌注。

    守种兽蹲在洞口，青铜身躯上的伤痕已自动修复了大半，但灵石核心的光芒仍然微弱。

    苏余将身上所有的灵石全部取出，将最精纯的几块塞进了守种兽胸甲接缝处的灵石嵌槽中。

    青铜机关兽发出一声低沉而满足的嗡鸣，眼窝里的晶石重新燃起了战斗的光芒。

    没有时间休息。

    苏余将七颗灵种连同周围的灵土一起小心地挖出来，分别用玉盒封好放入储物袋中。

    林霜将矿洞中遗留的所有物资和武器全部打包，包括那几件埋在地下的战利品——铜锤、九节鞭、判官笔和防御玉佩。

    这些法器虽不精良，但每件都能在黑市上卖出几十块灵石，对现在穷得叮当响的两人来说是一笔横财。

    第三天凌晨，天还没亮，两人便离开了废弃灵矿。

    苏余按照苏白石玉简上的地图找到了那座废弃传送阵——就在废矿以北约三十里处，隐藏在一片石林之中。

    传送阵由五根石柱围成，石柱表面刻满了古朴的篆文，与演武场、剑冢中看到的篆文同源。

    阵法核心的石台上有一个凹陷的掌印，形状与苏余手背上的“时”字篆文完全吻合。

    “这座传送阵是单向的，通往北域雪原。

    阵法激活后只能使用一次，使用后会自动损毁。”

    苏余将手背上的“时”字篆文按在掌印上，石柱上的篆文开始缓缓亮起暗金色的光芒，“阵法激活需要一炷香时间。

    激活期间不能被打断，否则灵力回路会彻底烧毁。”

    林霜拔出听霜剑，转身面对石林外围，站在了传送阵唯一的入口处。

    “你激活阵法，我守入口。”
content_en:
At dawn, the two left Kuliupo.

Instead of returning to Heishi Town, we headed northwest along the ancient river channel at the western foot of Heifeng Ridge.

Su Yu explained the plan on the way - the Tianji Pavilion news storm will reach its peak when the cave opens in three days.

After all the forces in the cave found out that the treasure was fake, all the spearheads of the investigation would point to the last person who came out of the secret realm - that is, him.

Within three days, all seven spiritual seeds and seed-keeping beasts in the abandoned mine must be moved to safer places.

Su Baishi's jade slips mentioned that there is an abandoned teleportation array deep in the Black Wind Ridge. It was an emergency passage built during the heyday of the Shi clan, leading to the snowfields of the northern region.

If the teleportation array can still be used, the transfer can be completed within three days.

After hearing this, Lin Shuang only said one sentence: "Let's go."

The two of them walked along the ancient river for a whole day and returned to the abandoned spiritual mine in the early morning of the next day.

The bloodthirsty vine at the entrance to the spirit mine has grown new dark red buds, and the seven seeds planted on the rock wall deep in the mine have all sprouted.

The buds of Chiyangguo are fiery red, and the two cotyledons have just emerged from the ground.

The buds of Bixinlan are emerald green and as thin as hair, and the air is filled with a very light orchid fragrance.

The buds of Snow Jade Ginseng are as pure as snow, with a drop of crystal dew condensed on the bud tip.

The buds of the ink marrow flower are as black as ink, and the cotyledons are covered with a layer of very fine silver hairs.

Among the other three nameless seeds, one has a pale golden bud, which is exactly the same as the nebula mark on Su Yu's palm.

The other two are still silent - they are waiting for a more intense infusion of time marks.

The Seed Keeper squatted at the entrance of the cave. Most of the scars on its bronze body had automatically repaired, but the light from the core of the spirit stone was still weak.

Su Yu took out all the spirit stones on his body and stuffed the purest few into the spirit stone slots at the seams of the Seed Keeper's breastplate.

The bronze mechanism beast let out a low and contented hum, and the crystals in its eye sockets rekindled the light of battle.

No time to rest.

Su Yu carefully dug out the seven spiritual seeds together with the surrounding spiritual soil, sealed them in jade boxes and put them into storage bags.

Lin Shuang packed up all the materials and weapons left in the mine, including the few trophies buried underground - the copper hammer, the nine-section whip, the judge's pen and the defensive jade pendant.

Although these magic weapons are not sophisticated, each one can be sold for dozens of spiritual stones on the black market, which is a windfall for the two people who are now very poor.

In the early morning of the third day, before dawn, the two left the abandoned spiritual mine.

Su Yu found the abandoned teleportation array according to the map on Su Baishi's jade slip - about thirty miles north of the abandoned mine, hidden in a stone forest.

The teleportation array is surrounded by five stone pillars. The surface of the stone pillars is covered with ancient seal scripts, which have the same origin as the seal scripts seen in the martial arts field and the sword tomb.

There is a sunken palm print on the stone platform at the core of the formation, and its shape exactly matches the seal character "Shi" on the back of Su Yu's hand.

“This teleportation array is one-way, leading to the snowfields of the Northern Territory.

The formation can only be used once after activation and will be automatically destroyed after use."

Su Yu pressed the seal character "Shi" on the back of his hand onto his palm print, and the seal character on the stone pillar began to slowly light up with a dark golden light, "It takes one stick of incense to activate the formation.

The activation period cannot be interrupted, otherwise the spiritual circuit will be completely burned out."

Lin Shuang pulled out the Tingshuang Sword, turned to face the outside of the stone forest, and stood at the only entrance to the teleportation array.

"You activate the formation, and I'll guard the entrance."
